tagline: Turn Notion pages into Todoist tasks and keep both in sync
metaTitle: How to Sync Notion with Todoist: Tasks from Your Pages
metaDescription: Stop retyping Notion action items into Todoist. GAIA pulls tasks from project pages and meeting notes, then marks them done in Notion. See the setup steps.
intro: Notion is where plans live. Todoist is where tasks get done. The divide between planning documents and actionable to-do lists means action items get buried in pages while your Todoist inbox doesn't reflect what your plans require. GAIA connects the two so plans translate automatically into tasks.

useCases.title: Extract tasks from Notion project pages
useCases.description: GAIA reads project pages, identifies action items and checkbox items, and creates corresponding Todoist tasks with due dates pulled from any dates mentioned in the page content.

useCases.title: Weekly review sync
useCases.description: During weekly reviews in Notion, action items you capture in your review page automatically become tasks for the coming week, closing the loop between reflection and execution.

useCases.title: Meeting notes to tasks
useCases.description: Action items captured in meeting notes become tasks assigned to the right project, so next-step commitments from meetings don't live only in documents.

useCases.title: Todoist completion synced to Notion
useCases.description: When you complete a task, GAIA marks the corresponding checkbox on the project page as checked, keeping your pages current with actual task completion status.

useCases.title: Goal tracking across both tools
useCases.description: Quarterly goals generate tasks that break down each goal into actionable steps, ensuring your big-picture plans have concrete daily actions attached.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Todoist to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Notion workspace (selecting the relevant pages/databases) and your Todoist account.
Choose whether sync runs one-way from pages to tasks, the other direction, or bidirectionally. Set how often GAIA should check for new items to sync.
Plans become tasks automatically. Completed tasks are reflected back in the planning pages. Your planning and execution systems become one coherent workflow.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Notion database items (not just page content) to Todoist?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can read databases and create tasks from database entries, mapping database properties (like due date, assignee, priority) to task attributes.

faqs.question: What happens if I edit a task after GAIA has synced it from its source page?
faqs.answer: By default, edits to the task don't overwrite the source page. GAIA treats the task list as the execution layer and the pages as the planning layer. You can configure bidirectional sync if you want changes on either side to update the other.

faqs.question: Does GAIA handle checkbox blocks specifically?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA recognizes checkbox blocks as tasks and can toggle them when the corresponding task is completed, keeping your pages accurate.
